title: The Missing Caravan
description: A supply caravan vanished on the road to Wolfpine. The village blames bandits, the guards blame smugglers, and the old shrine watches in silence.

not_started.summary: The party has not heard about the missing caravan.

accepted.summary: Captain Renna asked the party to search the Wolfpine Road.

found_wreck.summary: The party found signs of the caravan attack near the old shrine.

reported_clue.summary: The party reported the old shrine clue to Captain Renna.

accused_guards.summary: The party suspects Wolfpine's own guards are involved.

exposed_smugglers.summary: The party exposed a smuggler route tied to the caravan's disappearance.

resolved.summary: The missing caravan matter has been resolved.
